summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Multi-Tenant SaaS Platform features. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified Super Admin login, Platform Admin dashboard, Create Tenant flow with credentials modal, Suspend/Reactivate functionality, and Master Admin login.

Backend: Audit log endpoint works
Backend: Create tenant with auto-generated Master Admin credentials
Backend: Create tenant with custom admin email
Backend: Duplicate slug correctly rejected (400)

Backend: Suspend tenant functionality

Backend: Reactivate tenant functionality

critical_code_review_comments: Tenant isolation is properly implemented using TenantQueryBuilder
Role-based access control correctly restricts platform admin endpoints
Auto-generated Master Admin credentials use secure 12-char alphanumeric passwords
Tenant creation properly handles both auto-generated and custom admin emails
Suspend/Reactivate functionality correctly updates tenant status
JWT tokens properly encode tenant context and role information
seed_data_creation: Multiple test tenants created during testing with auto-generated Master Admin accounts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-tenant platform features fully functional. Key endpoints: POST /api/platform/tenants (create tenant), GET /api/platform/stats (dashboard stats), POST /api/platform/tenants/{id}/suspend, POST /api/platform/tenants/{id}/reactivate. Tenant creation returns master_admin credentials with email, password, and login_url. Role hierarchy: Super Admin > Master Admin > Admin > Staff. Tenant isolation verified - users cannot access other tenant's data.
